content: {"trailers": [{"title": "Betrayal & Revenge", "moment_ids": ["M003", "M009", "M018"], "hook": "Gerald abandons Juliana at the altar, but the stranger steps in to defend her.", "cliffhanger": "The stranger warns Gerald to choose his next words carefully.", "why": "It establishes the central conflict immediately: the villain's betrayal and the hero's violent protection."}, {"title": "The Poison Plot", "moment_ids": ["M086", "M089", "M096", "M097"], "hook": "Juliana discovers the Dowager Duchess's illness is unnatural and declares 'Arsenic'.", "cliffhanger": "Alexander trembles with terrified passion, warning, 'This time...'", "why": "It shifts the genre to a mystery thriller, highlighting the high stakes and the danger Juliana faces."}, {"title": "The Wedding Trap", "moment_ids": ["M142", "M144", "M148", "M149"], "hook": "Rupert and Catherine plot the public execution of Juliana at their wedding.", "cliffhanger": "Juliana realizes the wedding bells are tolling and grimly concludes, 'Then I suppose I'm next.'", "why": "It creates a ticking clock scenario and a high-stakes climax that hooks the viewer."}, {"title": "The Duke Returns", "moment_ids": ["M153", "M163", "M165", "M172"], "hook": "A loyalist soldier drops to his knee before Alexander, calling him 'Your Grace'.", "cliffhanger": "Alexander delivers the cold line, 'You were never my Duchess,' as Catherine breaks down in tears.", "why": "It focuses on the hero's return and the emotional climax of the villain's defeat."}]}
